messages:
rebecca (recruiter): heads up — after a batch candidate merge this morning several interviewers lost the `trained` label and the eval form link disappeared for them. noticed during loopup for 3 hires :thinking_face:

maria (people-ops): ugh. that sounds bad. do we have candidate ids or a merge job id? any pattern (same source, same days)?

rebecca (recruiter): merge job id `merge-2026-03-23-09` — affected candidates: C-3421, C-3422, C-3599. All were duplicates from the careers form.

kevin (eng): thanks. can you paste the webhook/merge payload (sanitized) or the event id? quick check: merge pipeline has a side-effect where we remap panel assignments — might be dropping custom labels if the target record has empty metadata.

rebecca (recruiter): pasted payload (sanitized):
```
{
  "merge_job": "merge-2026-03-23-09",
  "source": "careers-form",
  "merged_into": "C-3421",
  "removed_ids": ["C-3422","C-3599"],
  "panels": []
}
```

oliver (trainer): is this the same symptom as last quarter when the evalform pointer got nulled after an import? workaround then was to re-trigger `recalc-trainer-tags` for the candidate. ui route: Candidate > Actions > Recompute Training Status.

maria (people-ops): can we do that in bulk? we have ~12 interviewers affected across those panels and it's blocking next-week interviews.

kevin (eng): we can run a small backfill script against those candidate ids to recompute tags. i'll need the merge job id and a sample of the db row shape. will add a quick guard so we don't flip labels for legitimate merges.

rebecca (recruiter): merge job id up above. attaching a screenshot of the UI where eval link was missing — but can't attach here, i added to the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/REC-4317 :point_up:

recruiting-bot: automated event: merge-2026-03-23-09 processed at 2026-03-23T09:12:34Z, affected_count=3, handler=merge-service-v2

kevin (eng): ok i'll run the backfill now against C-3421,C-3422,C-3599 and report back in 20m. temporary mitigation: don't run any more merges from that careers-form workflow until i push a fix. tagging ops: @maria please pause scheduled dedupe jobs. :no_entry_sign:

maria (people-ops): paused dedupe schedule. thanks kevin. let us know when it's safe to resume.

kevin (eng): backfill done for the three ids — labels restored and eval links show for the interviewers. i pushed a small validation to the merge pipeline to copy over `panel_meta` if present. i'll open a PR for review.

rebecca (recruiter): verified — interviewers can access forms again. big thanks. can we add an alert when merge creates an empty `panels` array? would have caught this earlier. :pray:

kevin (eng): good call. adding a CI check + an alert. PR: https://github.com/redwood/ats/pull/4820 (wip). i'll follow up with postmortem notes in REC-4317.

maria (people-ops): marking this incident as "ops-impacting" and scheduling a 15m sync tomorrow to review mitigation and docs for the merging playbook.

rebecca (recruiter): will add affected interviewers to the candidate notes and notify hiring managers. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
